동안.forms: noun + 동안 (일주일 동안) · verb + -는 동안 (자는 동안)
동안.m: during, for (a period of time), while
동안.x: I studied Korean during the vacation.
동안.t: Use with a length of time: 두 시간 동안 = for two hours.

공부하다.x: I study together with my friend at the library.
공부하다.e: 공부 (study) + 하다 (do). Sino-Korean, but the parts don't add up — learn 공부 whole.

입원하다.m: to be hospitalized, to be admitted to a hospital
입원하다.ex: 아버지가 교통사고로 일주일 동안 병원에 입원하셨어요.
입원하다.x: My father was in the hospital for a week after a car accident.

광고.ex: 동영상을 볼 때마다 광고가 나와서 좀 짜증나요.
광고.x: An ad comes on every time I watch a video, which is a bit annoying.

동아리.x: After entering college, I joined a photography club.
동아리.e: Native word meaning 'a group of like-minded people'; the standard word for campus clubs.
동아리.t: 동아리 is used for school and college clubs; adult hobby groups are usually 동호회.

책임감.ex: 그 친구는 책임감이 강해서 일을 믿고 맡길 수 있어요.
책임감.x: That friend has a strong sense of responsibility, so I can trust them with work.
책임감.e: -감 = a feeling or sense of: 책임감, 자신감, 만족감.

중고.x: I bought a used bike to save money.
중고.t: Usually goes before a noun: 중고차, 중고 책, 중고 거래 (secondhand trading).

영원히.ex: 이 순간을 영원히 잊지 못할 거예요.
영원히.x: I will never forget this moment.

반려동물.ex: 저희 아파트는 반려동물을 키울 수 있어요.
반려동물.x: Pets are allowed in our apartment building.
반려동물.t: Pronounced [발려동물]. Now preferred over 애완동물; also 반려견 'companion dog' and 반려묘 'companion cat'.

충치.ex: 단 걸 많이 먹어서 충치가 생겼어요.
충치.x: I ate a lot of sweets and got a cavity.
충치.e: Literally 'worm tooth', from the old belief that worms ate holes in teeth.
충치.t: A cavity 'forms': 충치가 생기다. Getting one treated is 충치 치료.

납치.x: The police safely rescued the kidnapped child.
납치.t: 납치되다 = to be kidnapped; it is also used for planes: 비행기 납치 = hijacking.

쟁점.ex: 이번 선거의 가장 큰 쟁점은 집값이에요.
쟁점.x: The biggest issue in this election is housing prices.

메스껍다.x: When I'm on a boat for a long time, I feel queasy.
메스껍다.e: Almost always with 속 'insides': 속이 메스껍다 = to feel sick to your stomach.

뭉클하다.m: touched, moved (feeling a lump in your chest)
뭉클하다.x: I was moved when I read my parents' letter.
뭉클하다.e: Sound-symbolic: like a soft lump welling up in your chest.
뭉클하다.t: Usually with 가슴 or 마음: 가슴이 뭉클하다.

냉담하다.ex: 새 정책에 대한 시민들의 반응은 냉담했습니다.
냉담하다.x: Citizens' reaction to the new policy was cold.
냉담하다.e: Literally 'cold and bland' — showing no warmth or interest.

독점하다.m: to monopolize, to have all to oneself
독점하다.ex: 동생이 텔레비전 리모컨을 하루 종일 독점했어요.
독점하다.x: My little brother hogged the TV remote all day.

군사력.ex: 그 나라는 해마다 군사력을 키우고 있습니다.
군사력.x: That country is building up its military strength every year.

당연시하다.m: to take for granted, to regard as natural
당연시하다.x: We shouldn't take our parents' sacrifices for granted.

공헌.ex: 그 과학자는 의학 발전에 큰 공헌을 했어요.
공헌.x: That scientist made a great contribution to the advancement of medicine.
공헌.e: Literally 'tribute and offering' — what you present to a cause.

집단 따돌림.ex: 학교에서 집단 따돌림을 당하는 학생을 도와야 해요.
집단 따돌림.x: We need to help students who are being bullied at school.
집단 따돌림.e: 따돌림 comes from 따돌리다 'to leave someone out.'
집단 따돌림.t: The usual verb is 당하다: 집단 따돌림을 당하다, 'to be bullied by a group.'

촉매제.ex: 이번 정책이 경제 성장의 촉매제 역할을 했어요.
촉매제.x: This policy acted as a catalyst for economic growth.
촉매제.e: Literally 'a touching medium agent': it speeds things up by contact without being used up.
촉매제.t: Pronounced [총매제] — nasalization; common pattern: X의 촉매제 역할을 하다.

죄형법정주의.m: principle of legality (no crime or punishment without law)
죄형법정주의.ex: 죄형법정주의에 따라 법에 없는 행위는 처벌할 수 없습니다.
죄형법정주의.x: Under the principle of legality, acts not defined by law cannot be punished.
죄형법정주의.e: Literally 'crime-and-punishment-fixed-by-law-ism': no crime without a prior law.

행정소송.ex: 주민들은 시청의 결정에 불복해 행정소송을 냈어요.
행정소송.x: The residents rejected city hall's decision and filed an administrative suit.
행정소송.e: Literally 'lawsuit over administration': challenging a public authority's decision.

국제수지.ex: 국제수지는 한 나라와 외국 사이의 모든 거래를 보여 줍니다.
국제수지.x: The balance of payments shows all transactions between a country and the rest of the world.
국제수지.e: 수지 is literally 'income and outgo': money in versus money out.
국제수지.t: 수지가 맞다 means 'to pay off, be profitable', a common everyday phrase.

적폐.ex: 새 정부는 적폐 청산을 가장 중요한 과제로 내세웠어요.
적폐.x: The new government made rooting out deep-seated corruption its top priority.
적폐.t: Almost always used in the political slogan 적폐 청산 (cleaning up accumulated evils).

특별검사.ex: 특별검사가 대통령 측근의 비리를 수사하고 있어요.
특별검사.x: The special prosecutor is investigating corruption by the president's close aides.
특별검사.e: Literally 'specially appointed prosecutor', chosen outside the regular prosecution.

기면증.ex: 기면증이 있으면 낮에도 갑자기 잠이 들어요.
기면증.x: With narcolepsy, you suddenly fall asleep even during the day.

적개심.ex: 전쟁 후에도 두 나라 사이의 적개심은 쉽게 사라지지 않았어요.
적개심.x: Even after the war, hostility between the two countries didn't easily disappear.
적개심.e: Literally 'rage toward an enemy in one's heart'.

상감.x: Goryeo celadon is famous for its unique inlay technique.
상감.e: A design is carved into the surface, then filled with clay of another color.
상감.t: Usually appears in compounds: 상감 기법 (inlay technique), 상감청자 (inlaid celadon).

동상이몽.m: same bed, different dreams; sharing a situation but having different goals
동상이몽.ex: 두 회사는 손을 잡았지만 사실은 동상이몽이에요.
동상이몽.x: The two companies joined hands, but in reality they want different things.
동상이몽.t: Very common in politics and business news about partners with conflicting aims.

유기적.ex: 각 부서가 유기적으로 협력해야 성과가 납니다.
유기적.x: Results come only when each department cooperates closely.
유기적.e: Literally 'having a mechanism' — parts working together like a living body.

간담상조.ex: 두 사람은 간담상조하는 사이라 비밀이 없어요.
간담상조.x: The two are such close friends that they keep no secrets.
간담상조.e: Literally 'liver and gall shown to each other': revealing your innermost self.

일도양단.m: settling something decisively in one stroke
일도양단.ex: 그 문제는 일도양단으로 해결할 수 있는 일이 아니에요.
일도양단.x: That problem isn't something you can settle with a single decisive stroke.
